cwe_content.cwe: CWE-532,Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

candidate.Reason: When mysqldump fails to execute (e.g., not found in PATH), the ProcessExecutor will log the command execution details including environment variables. The MYSQL_PWD environment variable containing the database password is set in the process environment and could be leaked through the process execution logs.

Database password is stored in MYSQL_PWD environment variable which is passed to the ProcessExecutor. If mysqldump is not available and the process fails to execute, this sensitive information could be exposed in error logs or process execution details.

cwe_content.cwe: CWE-532,Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

candidate.Reason: When pg_dump fails due to missing binary, the error handling logs the exit code and may expose process execution details that could include environment variables containing sensitive database credentials in the error output stream redirected to SLF4J logs
Redirects both stdout and stderr to SLF4J debug logs, which could capture environment variables including PGPASSWORD when pg_dump fails due to missing binary
Redirects stderr to SLF4J debug logs, which may contain environment information including sensitive credentials when the backup process fails
